title: Dev builds go to ./bin/tk, never machine-wide
description: Building tk straight over ~/.local/bin/tk during development replaces the binary every other agent on the machine is using, and silently reverts any local patch it carried — it did exactly that here, reverting the hand-bumped herdr protocol and obstructing other agents mid-task. Machine-wide installs should happen on release, not while dev is in flight. Make the dev path obvious and the machine-wide path deliberate: a documented build target that writes ./bin/tk, a note in CONTRIBUTING/README, and ideally a guard so an accidental install over the machine-wide binary has to be asked for explicitly.
